about_the_game:
We are creating a game based on the world of "Depth", the flagship title of Werewolf: The Playing Theater (TLPT), which has captivated audiences with its intense performances.

The original planning and overall supervision are handled by Jiro Ishii, well known for his work on 428: Shibuya Scramble and many other acclaimed titles.

Pushed to the brink of extinction by a pandemic, humanity's last hope lies in a deep-sea facility.

But when a werewolf infiltrates the crew, the brilliant scientists are thrust into a deadly game of suspicion.

Can you unravel the mystery of Depth Loop and secure humanity's future?

As a player, join the Werewolf game!

This title combines the rich, immersive storytelling unique to visual novels with the strategic depth of repeatedly playing a looping Werewolf game to ultimately reach the conclusion.

With over 30 hours of total playtime, you can fully immerse yourself in the world and enjoy it to the fullest.

◆ Game Flow

The game features twelve genius researchers from around the world, along with the player, werewolves, mermaids, and a commander.

Under orders from the commander, the player is dispatched to the deep-sea special facility “Mag Mell,” where they must participate in Werewolf games with the researchers to uncover its mysteries.

Depending on the outcome of each Werewolf game, the story progresses, gradually revealing the characters’ pasts and the secrets of “Mag Mell.”

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 and up
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 4GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This app features mouse, keyboard controls and partial controller support with the Xbox controller.

short_description: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?
